pinned_inventory.generation_validation: Generator verifies every relevant package/archive file byte-for-byte, exact instrumentation anchors, registry counts, and pinned archive/dist hashes; this map validates the pinned inventory and regenerates native symbol tables byte-identically against checked-in sources.

method: Reviewed actual parser branches/refusals, contextual parser handling and exact mode-specific generated-symbol fallback keys; builtin macros by generated templates and explicit callable allowlist; symbols by pinned generated tables; Unicode runtime rows by Math_Unicode token paths; scriptData by item-specific substitution evidence; settings by engine surfaces/rejections. Stable IDs and ordered source hashes make regeneration deterministic; no semantic or qualification status is claimed.

requirements.evidence_and_unmet: Census/crosswalk exist; reviewed qualification decisions and case links remain absent.
Expander/templates exist; complete argument, scope, and built-in semantics remain unqualified.
Fresh/shared contexts exist; complete state-sequence qualification remains open.

Generated Math_Unicode decompositions, 12 accent mappings, and 102 script substitutions now feed tokenization; 344 raw Unicode symbol paths are inventoried. Runtime coverage is partial: scriptData's seven block ranges remain absent as a substitution table, and full Unicode shaping/geometry is unqualified.

Font/style mappings and size commands are source-present, including tiny (0.5) and sixptsize (0.6); the latest focused geometry corpus passes 145/145 cases. This remains scoped evidence and does not establish full-width origin/measurement or qualification.
Partial parser/environment support mapped; parser-present environments and aliases remain partial/unqualified, and remaining constructs are missing or partial.

Several settings have partial native surfaces; exact option parity remains unqualified. fleqn is explicitly rejected. trust=False is the enforced profile and trust=True is rejected; colorIsTextColor has a parser candidate branch but no option wiring and remains unvalidated. D11/D12 apply only to their approved callback/API deviations.
Diagnostics/source fallback exist; error-fragment and source-position parity unqualified.
The core default trust=false is maintained and sensitive commands are refused; full policy equivalence unqualified.
Job queue/source ledger exist; ledger is not CPU/work budgeting or cooperative cancellation.
Native integration exists; complete compatibility regression evidence remains open.
Semantic-tree source exists; no completed human assistive-technology review.

The frozen 16-case differential pilot and 3-image pilot are scoped evidence only; later focused geometry evidence includes failures, and full-width origin/measurement remains unmeasured. Full per-entry corpus, browser/platform pins, recorded outcome snapshots, approved thresholds, and qualification remain incomplete.

Regression-suite chronology and the latest authoritative result are recorded in the current STR; earlier run counts are historical evidence only. A green regression count is not compatibility qualification.
Pinned generators/provenance exist; full repeatable qualification and upgrade review unqualified.
